player_prompt.intro:
Wamkelekile kwiFrozen Lake!

Ukuvunyelwa yibhi 'P' kwi grid.
Izibelo zesigidi:
  ' ' = Isipha esifuthulwe (sihlamvu kudlula ngalo)
  'H' = Ihole (wa kuyo na uphume!
  'G' = Inhloso (fika lazi uwinhe!
  'P' = Indawo yakho eyadinga

Izinto ezinjenjwayo: phezulu, pantsi, kwempuma, kwnye (noma w, a, s, d)
Xela izinto zakho njengokuba: [up], [down], [left], [right] noma [w], [a], [s], [d]

Inhloso: Hamba ukususela kwiqala (phezulu-kwempuma) kwiinhloso (pantsi-kwnye) ukungabi ngapha kwiinhlobo zanyana!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomati yezinto ezijenjwayo ibuhlulu. Sebenzisa [up], [down], [left], [right] noma [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Isenzo esingaziwayo '{action}'. Sebenzisa phezulu, ezantsi, ekhohlo, ngasekunene okanye w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Uwele emngxunyeni! Umdlalo uphelile. Ugqibezele {pct}% yohambo oluya kwicala lokugqibela.
outcome.turn_limit: Ufikelele kumda wenguqu! Umdlalo uphelile. Ugqibezele {pct}% yohambo oluya kwinjongo.
